title: Kageyama Tamio no Double Fantasy
justification: Checked by title. Anime-Lists has no TVDB id for this node; it takes the tv special marker. 景山民夫のダブルファンタジー is a two-part TBS television special of 1994-01-02 (サイケデリック航空 and 南洋ホテル). TheTVDB has no series or movie for it under its Japanese, romaji or English titles or either part title (the only Double Fantasy series, 346396, is a 2018 live-action drama), so the node takes the tv special marker.
